summary: Keep Mealie recipes handy in a counter-friendly cooking view.
page_description: A Mealie companion that keeps tonight's recipe legible, awake, and usable offline at the counter.
release_notes: Rebuilt on a renderer that keeps every control reachable at the largest text sizes, and on a keyboard that can type every character this app asks for.

steps.text: Make the Mealie API available to the Kobo at https://mealie.local.
Create a long-lived Mealie API token and install it under the exact name mealie.

user: Somebody who cooks with the reader propped on the counter.
job: Keep your Mealie recipes readable and awake while you cook.
offline: Recipes you have kept work without the network; fetching new ones does not.

data.location: the app's private storage on the reader
data.export: not offered; the originals stay in your Mealie

capabilities_required.name: network
capabilities_required.purpose: to fetch recipes from your Mealie

capabilities_optional.name: keep-awake
capabilities_optional.gates: keeping a recipe up while you cook

non_goals: It does not plan meals or shopping lists.
